roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring our team is well-trained and our environment is safe for all residents.In this dual capacity, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive staff training programs, fostering continuous professional growth, and leading our infection control initiatives. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining high standards of care and compliance within our skilled nursing facility.This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent. If you are a passionate RN with a knack for education and a strong understanding of infection control, we encourage you to apply and make a significant impact on our team and residents.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or nursing education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.
